cases.sentence: Только в ___ жизни он чувствовал, что будет в состоянии понять самого себя и всё то, что̀ он видел и испытал.
cases.explain: «обычных условиях» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The one thing he now desired with his whole soul was to get away quickly from the terrible sensations amid which he had lived that day and return to ordinary conditions of life and sleep quietly in a room in his own bed. He felt that only in the ordinary conditions of life would he be able to understand himself and all he had seen and felt. But such ordinary conditions of life were nowhere to be found.

cases.sentence: Но этих ___ жизни нигде не было.
cases.explain: «обычных условий» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The one thing he now desired with his whole soul was to get away quickly from the terrible sensations amid which he had lived that day and return to ordinary conditions of life and sleep quietly in a room in his own bed. He felt that only in the ordinary conditions of life would he be able to understand himself and all he had seen and felt. But such ordinary conditions of life were nowhere to be found.

cases.sentence: Пройдя версты три по большой ___, Пьер сел на краю ее.
cases.explain: «Можайской дороге» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Having gone a couple of miles along the Mozháysk road, Pierre sat down by the roadside.

cases.sentence: Беспрестанно ему казалось, что с ___ налетало на него ядро; он вздрагивал и приподнимался.
cases.explain: «страшным свистом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Dusk had fallen, and the roar of guns died away. Pierre lay leaning on his elbow for a long time, gazing at the shadows that moved past him in the darkness. He was continually imagining that a cannon ball was flying toward him with a terrific whizz, and then he shuddered and sat up. He had no idea how long he had been there. In the middle of the night three soldiers, having brought some firewood, settled down near him and began lighting a fire.

cases.explain: «Другой солдат» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: В ___ солдаты вместе с Пьером пошли к Можайску.
cases.explain: «совершенной темноте» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In the total darkness the soldiers walked with Pierre to Mozháysk.

cases.sentence: Пьер шел вместе с солдатами, совершенно забыв, что его ___ был внизу под горою и что он уже прошел его.
cases.explain: «постоялый двор» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: By the time they got near Mozháysk and began ascending the steep hill into the town, the cocks were already crowing. Pierre went on with the soldiers, quite forgetting that his inn was at the bottom of the hill and that he had already passed it. He would not soon have remembered this, such was his state of forgetfulness, had he not halfway up the hill stumbled upon his groom, who had been to look for him in the town and was returning to the inn. The groom recognized Pierre in the darkness by his white hat.

cases.sentence: Он бы не вспомнил этого (в таком он находился состоянии потерянности), ежели бы с ним не столкнулся на половине горы его берейтор, ходивший его отыскивать по городу и возвращавшийся назад к своему ___.
cases.explain: «постоялому двору» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: By the time they got near Mozháysk and began ascending the steep hill into the town, the cocks were already crowing. Pierre went on with the soldiers, quite forgetting that his inn was at the bottom of the hill and that he had already passed it. He would not soon have remembered this, such was his state of forgetfulness, had he not halfway up the hill stumbled upon his groom, who had been to look for him in the town and was returning to the inn. The groom recognized Pierre in the darkness by his white hat.

cases.sentence: — Прощайте, — сказал Пьер и направился с своим берейтором к ___.
cases.explain: «постоялому двору» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “Goodbye!” he said and turned with his groom toward the inn.

cases.sentence: В горницах ___ не было места: все были заняты.
cases.explain: «постоялого двора» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There was not a room to be had at the inn, they were all occupied. Pierre went out into the yard and, covering himself up head and all, lay down in his carriage.
